answer_1.quote: End-to-end open-domain dialog systems have become increasingly powerful... In this work, we move beyond simple prediction of response relevance, augmenting this with a prediction of how likely a response is to elicit a positive reaction from an interlocutor.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate ranker performance using two metrics. First, we use pairwise accuracy... Second... Spearman's ρ... We also evaluated performance on feedback data... using Hits@k...

answer_4.quote: we present pairs of responses for the same context to a set of human annotators, asking them to select the response they would prefer to send or receive. The annotation is conducted for machine-vs.-machine comparisons on 1K pairs, and with 5 individual judges for each pair.
